title: 第240章 她是你的姘头吗第239章 花耶的父亲
slug: 降临即邪神开局绑架女武神
content_zh:
毫无疑问，仅仅从这些内部的资料中就能够看出，花耶的父亲在当时绝对是一个炽手可热的天才。
他确实配得上这样的履历。
因为在公开的资料当中，他也是二十年前少数几个能够跟着奥菲希尔对抗绯红之主的人物，并且也就是在那之后，他就一举成为了驱魔师协会的副会长，站在了名利场的巅峰。
林恩翻阅着他剩余的资料。
而从后面的记载当中也能够看出，他在那个时候也被整个发条城给予了厚望，甚至他一度成为了发条城在对外方面的代表，是那个时代真正崛起的领军人物。
但是之后随着一件事情的发生，这位曾经炽手可热的天才却是慢慢淡出了人们的视野……
他再次想起了泰瑞尔之前他说过的那些话。
“他妻子的死么……”
林恩的目光闪烁。
但无论他当时到底知不知道他妻子的身份，但如果泰瑞尔之前和他说的都是真的的话，那在后续的过程中，他确实和绯红之主进行过接触。
甚至可能已经达成了某种交易。
而他的离开也非常的蹊跷。
因为也就是在这段时间里，花耶不止一次地遭受到了灵界方面的悬赏，他一直在为自己制造不在场的证明。
“可如果真的是他的话，他为什么要对奥菲希尔出手？”
林恩低声自语。
而从资料中也能看出，在他年少成名的那段时间，奥菲希尔一直都对他非常的照顾，整个发条城的资源几乎都在向他们倾泻。
一个是他，而另一个就是花耶的母亲。
尽管从现在的角度来说，他已经知道了花耶的母亲是红月家族的人，但是从当时的情况来说，一个发条城本土崛起的顶级天才，一个则是她倾尽心血培养的代表教会的佼佼者，能看着发条城当中有这么两位新生代的崛起，奥菲希尔当时绝对是非常欣慰的。
而尽管在之后发生了那样的事情……
可奥菲希尔毕是竟她妻子的老师，并且曾经提携过他。

“他真的一点旧情都不顾了么？”
林恩的目光闪烁地自语。
但其实他也知道。
一个人如果真的已经彻底堕落的话，那谈这些便已是毫无意义。
只是他唯一不清楚的是，花耶的母亲在死去时到底发生了什么，当时奥菲希尔她是不是也在场，她到底知不知道她那个学生的身份，因为仅有的两次听她谈起那时候的事情时，她每次都会流露出浓重的痛苦和伤心。
林恩站了起来，望着手中的档案，道：
“不管怎么样，先从他查起吧，不管对奥菲希尔动手的是不是他，至少要确定他的位置，如果他真的已经回到了发条城……”
林恩的手微微地握紧。
他绝对不会让他把花耶带走的。
柩没有说话，只是目光注视着他，听着他的自言自语。
而毫无疑问。
至少从目前来说，这个身份存疑的神选，确实是对她姊妹的事情十分上心。
没有犹豫，林恩立刻拿起了印象水晶，立刻向待命的莫干斯和那五个主教下达了命令。
而首先可以确认的是，他虽然早就已经不再是驱魔师协会的副会长，但是作为幽织家的家主，他也必然在城里有着自己的社交网络，而花耶既然说他去了其他的城市，那就先从明面上查起，确定他的行踪。
而如果他真的已经回到了发条城……
林恩眯眼。
“看来有必要再去他家里一趟了。”
……
……
而在有了怀疑之后，说实话，林恩现在也已经不太敢把花耶独自一个人留在这个地方了。

虽然说大圣堂有着整个发条城最坚固的防御，但是连奥菲希尔都几乎遇难，他也已经不确定这个地方能不能保住花耶的安全了，而一旦她被她的父亲交到绯红之主的手里，那他就会彻底地陷入被动，而到时候就不是他想不想在这个地方待的问题了。
那就是为红月女王的诞生献上心脏，自己赶紧卷铺盖跑路的问题了。
不过还好。
虽然奥菲希尔重伤不醒，但是来了一个更加强大的柩，至少在目前的情况之下，只要能把这个女人pua在身边，自己也就暂时不怕被岳父突脸了。
content_en:
There is no doubt that just from these internal information, it can be seen that Huaye's father was definitely a blazing genius at the time.
He certainly deserves this resume.
Because according to the public information, he was one of the few people who could follow Ophihir to fight against the Crimson Lord twenty years ago, and it was after that that he became the vice president of the Exorcist Association, standing at the pinnacle of Vanity Fair.
Lynn flipped through the rest of his information.
It can also be seen from the subsequent records that he was also given high hopes by the entire Clockwork City at that time. He even became the representative of Clockwork City in terms of external affairs for a time, and was a truly rising leader of that era.
But then something happened, and this once-hot genius slowly faded out of people’s sight...
He thought again of what Tyrael had said before.
"The death of his wife..."
Linn's eyes flickered.
But regardless of whether he knew the identity of his wife at the time, if what Tyrell told him before was true, then he did have contact with the Crimson Lord in the subsequent process.
There may even have been some kind of deal struck.
And his departure was also very strange.
Because it was during this period that Huaye suffered bounties from the spiritual world more than once, and he had been creating proof of his alibi.
"But if it was really him, why would he attack Aoifei Xier?"
Linn whispered to himself.
It can also be seen from the information that during the period when he became famous at a young age, Ofishil always took great care of him, and almost all the resources of the Clockwork City were poured into them.
One is him, and the other is Huaye's mother.
Although from the current point of view, he already knew that Huaye's mother was from the Red Moon family, but from the situation at that time, one was a top genius who had risen in Clockwork City, and the other was a leader who represented the church that she had devoted her efforts to cultivate. Offishier was definitely very pleased to see the rise of such two new generations in Clockwork City.
And even though what happened later...
But Ophihir is her wife's teacher after all, and she once supported him.
"Does he really not care about his old feelings at all?"
Linn's eyes flickered and she said to herself.
But in fact he also knew.
If a person is really completely depraved, then there is no point in talking about it.
But the only thing he didn't know was what exactly happened when Huaye's mother died. Was Offishier also present at the time? Did she know the identity of her student? Because the only two times he heard her talk about what happened at that time, she would show deep pain and sadness each time.
Lin En stood up, looked at the file in his hand, and said:
"No matter what, let's start with him first. Regardless of whether he was the one who attacked Ofishiel, we must at least determine his location. If he has really returned to Clockwork City..."
Linn's hands clenched slightly.
He would never let him take Huaye away.
Coffin didn't speak, just stared at him and listened to his talking to himself.
And there is no doubt about it.
At least for now, this divine choice with questionable identity is indeed very concerned about her sister's affairs.
Without hesitation, Linn immediately picked up the impression crystal and immediately issued an order to Morgans and the five bishops who were on standby.
The first thing that can be confirmed is that although he is no longer the vice-president of the Exorcist Association, as the head of the Yuzhi family, he must have his own social network in the city. Since Hua Ye said that he went to other cities, he should first investigate the obvious and determine his whereabouts.
And if he has really returned to Clockwork City...
Lynn narrowed her eyes.
"It seems that it is necessary to go to his house again."
…
……
而在有了怀疑之后，说实话，林恩现在也已经不太敢把花耶独自一个人留在这个地方了。
Although the Great Holy Cathedral has the strongest defense in the entire Clockwork City, even Ophihir was almost killed. He is no longer sure whether this place can keep Huaye safe. Once she is handed over to the Crimson Lord by her father, he will be completely passive, and then it will not be a question of whether he wants to stay in this place.
那就是为红月女王的诞生献上心脏，自己赶紧卷铺盖跑路的问题了。
But it's okay.
Although Ophihir was seriously injured and unconscious, a more powerful coffin came. At least under the current situation, as long as he could keep this woman by his side, he would not be afraid of being betrayed by his father-in-law for the time being.
